name: DemonstratorFleetManager
tagline: Run your demo cars like a business: limits, de-fleet, OEM claims and staff cars in one app.
description: A complete demonstrator fleet app for car dealers: lifecycle board, age and mileage limit monitoring, projected de-fleet planner with value estimates, OEM demo support claim tracking with deadlines, and staff assignment with a one-car-per-person policy. Works instantly with sample data in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Allowed lifecycle moves with required fields per status
Age and mileage limits with warning threshold
Projected de-fleet date (age vs mileage rate) and planned dates
Linear value estimate per car and per month
OEM demo support eligibility, claim window and deadline countdown
Search, sort, group, filters, bulk status change, CSV export, undo
Phone bottom bar and card layouts
Power Fx outputs and events (OnSelect, OnChange, OnCreate, OnSave, OnAction, OnStatusChange)
